title: Eric Wargo's Time Loops theory of precognition
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Eric Wargo's Time Loops theory of precognition, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And it produces some sort of theory as to how this might work. And it it involves the the brain being sort of this hybrid classical quantum computer where we can access future knowledge states.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a book called Time Loops by the writer Eric Wargo, which offers a theory of precognition, the idea of knowing things before they happen. Michels says the book treats the brain as a kind of hybrid of an ordinary computer and a quantum computer that can reach information from the future. If true, glimpses of the future would have a physical explanation.
